messages:
maria_support: Hi team — NordicBank just escalated a GDPR erasure request for a Dedicated tenant in eu-west. Customer says our API returned 500 on their initial erase call and later they saw a billing spike. Can someone help confirm where the delete stopped and gather KMS/audit proof?
oleg_eng: Sorry seeing this now. Can you paste the root request_id and the error blob? 500 could be our side or KMS rewrap failure.
maria_support: request_id: rq_0a1b2c3d, customer timestamp: 2026-03-15T09:12:22Z. Error from our logs: `{"level":"error","msg":"rewrap failed","kms_status":401,"kms_key":"projects/tenant-987/locations/global/keyRings/ring-42/cryptoKeys/key-eu-01"}`. Also attached the customer's screenshot of API response: `{"error":"erasure_failed","detail":"kms unauthorized"}`.
cicero_sre: :eyes: That 401 indicates our service principal couldn't call the customer's CMK or their subprocessor KMS (depending on Dedicated config). Is this Dedicated with tenant-managed key (CMK) or Redwood-managed?
maria_support: Confirmed: Dedicated with customer CMK (customer provided key) via cross-account rewrap. They said they rotated keys last week.
oleg_eng: Ok — most likely rewrap token failed after rotation. Two immediate asks: 1) can ops pull audit log for the KMS key from the customer's key ring? we need the entry for rq_0a1b2c3d. 2) @daphne_privacy we need to confirm DPA implications if rewrap fails mid-erasure (i.e., what to tell the customer re: proof backlog).
daphne_privacy: If rewrap fails and data remains encrypted under old envelope key, we must document attempted deletion and produce transient evidence (delete command + error logs + KMS deny). That satisfies 'attempted erasure' timeline while we remediate. We still need final removal confirmation within the DPA SLA — please escalate to infra to retry.
oleg_eng: Repro step for infra: from a node in eu-west run: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_TOKEN" -X POST "https://kms.partner.example.com/v1/projects/tenant-987/locations/global/keyRings/ring-42/cryptoKeys:keyRewrap" -d '{"ciphertext":"<ct>"}'``` Expect 200/403/401. Paste raw response.
maria_support: Ran with customer's test token (sanitized): response was 401 with body `{"error":"unauthorized_client","message":"service account not permitted to use key"}`.
cicero_sre: That matches. Likely the customer's IAM policy removed our service account during their rotation. Two immediate mitigations: a) attempt erase via fallback key (we have a secondary envelope for short window) b) open a support action to the customer to re-grant access or provide a rewrap token. Which route did the customer prefer?
maria_support: They asked us to proceed without more customer action if possible. They quoted DPA window of 72h.
oleg_eng: We can attempt fallback rewrap. Steps I ran (priv infra): 1) queued job id job_erasure_2234 to run rewrap using fallback envelope 2) job attempted rewrap and showed partial success: `{"job":"job_erasure_2234","status":"partial","details":"10/18 shards rewrapped; 8/18 kms_401"}`.
daphne_privacy: Document that as attempted remediation. Prepare evidence bundle: include API request/response, job logs, KMS 401 audit lines, and timeline. We'll need to redact customer PII but include key resource names.
ben_billing: On billing spike: looks like erasure retried and tokens retried caused tokenized generation + storage churn. I'll flag potential credit. Please include the cost delta and request a billing review ID.
maria_support: Uploaded logs to internal storage: link https://vault.internal/reports/erasure/rq_0a1b2c3d (access: support+privacy). What exact KMS audit lines do you need?
oleg_eng: Need the KMS Admin Audit event showing `SetIamPolicy` and `Decrypt`/`AsymmetricSign` failures around 2026-03-15T09:00-09:30Z. Also the rewrap request entries showing the 401 response. If customer's KMS supports `accessDenied` vs `unauthorized_client` we should capture that verbatim.
maria_support: Got a filtered snippet from the customer's keyring audit (sanitized): `timestamp: 2026-03-15T09:12:23Z, protoPayload.methodName: "google.iam.admin.v1.SetIamPolicy", principal: "serviceAccount:redwood-inference@app.tenant-987.iam.gserviceaccount.com", status: { code: 7, message: "PERMISSION_DENIED" }` and `timestamp: 2026-03-15T09:12:25Z, protoPayload.methodName: "kms.cryptoKeyVersions.decrypt", principal: "serviceAccount:redwood-inference@app.tenant-987.iam.gserviceaccount.com", status: { code: 16, message: "Unauthenticated" }`.
cicero_sre: Good. That demonstrates an IAM deny. Daphne — with these events is the evidence bundle sufficient for initial compliance submission (they often accept the deny + attempted deletion timeline)?
daphne_privacy: Yes, that's acceptable as interim evidence. But we need final proof that the ciphertext was re-encrypted (rewrapped) and records of object deletion from blob storage. If fallback rewrap finishes, include rewrap success logs and the storage delete entry `DeleteObject: path/to/tenant-987/user-5309.json` with timestamp.
oleg_eng: Status update: fallback job retried overnight and final run succeeded for remaining shards. From infra logs: `{"job":"job_erasure_2234","status":"complete","rewrap_success":18,"timestamp":"2026-03-16T02:04:10Z"}`. Storage deletion event: `DeleteObject user-5309.json, bucket: tenant-987-erasure, time:2026-03-16T02:04:12Z`.
maria_support: Shared the completed evidence bundle with customer (redacted) and opened ticket CS-89421 for compliance. I also attached the minimal timeline and included the IAM audit lines above.
daphne_privacy: Great. Next steps for process: ask infra to set a flag to detect CMK IAM changes during rotations and notify support automatically. Also we should update our DPA runbook with fallback-rewrap timelines.
cicero_sre: Will add a monitor that looks for KMS 401s during erasure pipelines and auto-notify oncall.
ben_billing: Billing review requested (BR-1120). Recommend offering pro-rated credits for repeated retries — I'll follow up with finance.
maria_support: Customer acknowledged receipt and asked for final legal bundle via secure transfer. I've scheduled delivery and CC'd @daphne_privacy. Closing here unless someone else needs more artifacts. :white_check_mark:
